macros.name: Cascade
macros.doc: The LaTeX package cascade provides a command \Cascade to do constructions to present mathematical demonstrations with successive braces for the deductions.

macros.name: CascadeOptions
macros.doc: The options can also be given at the document level with the command \CascadeOptions.

macros.name: Edacsac
macros.doc: The command \Edacsac (cascade written in reverse) is similar to the command \Cascade but with braces going backwards.
